_comment: Hackers (1995) Gibson supercomputer — cyan-on-void glass canyons. Seed of the 2D/3D-mixed FUI family. Pairs with layout=mixed3d. Danger phase swaps cyan for red/orange + purple beam-bursts; flag is mixed3d.danger.

data._comment: Cyan-dominant ladder: cat[0..3] all cyan-family (varying lightness/saturation) so 2-4 category treemaps stay inside the cyan envelope, with one mid-blue at [1] for legibility separation. Violet then pink at [4..5] only fire on 5+ categories — matches the rare-highlight rule from feedback_hackers_cyan_dominant. Pre-2026-05-23 cat[1] was #9966ff which painted the 2nd-largest treemap category in purple, dominating the cyan field at common 2-3 category counts (probed live during pack-2D audit).
